# Forget Me Not

> A recurring-task tracker that lives entirely in your browser. Tasks have a
> cadence ("every 2 hours"), build urgency as they come due, and reset when you
> check them off. No account, no server: everything is in localStorage.

## For AI agents

This page exposes a scripting API at `window.fmn` so you can configure someone's
tasks by calling functions — you do not need to click through the UI.

Run JavaScript on https://tasks.lucianlabs.ca and start with:

    fmn.help()

That returns the full method list, the accepted duration formats, and examples,
as data. Every method returns a JSON-serializable object. Failures come back as
`{ok: false, error: "..."}` rather than throwing.

### Common calls

    fmn.listTasks()                          // everything, most urgent first
    fmn.listTasks({overdueOnly: true})       // just what needs doing now
    fmn.createTask({title: "stretch", cadence: "45m", category: "health"})
    fmn.createTasks([...])                   // several at once
    fmn.completeTask(id)                     // check it off, restart its cycle
    fmn.updateTask(id, {cadence: "3 days"})
    fmn.setTheme("sakura")
    fmn.exportData() / fmn.importData(json)  // whole-dataset backup + restore

### Durations

Anywhere a cadence is accepted, write it how you'd say it: "90s", "15m", "2h",
"3 days", "1h 30m", "every 2 hours", "every day", or "daily"/"weekly"/"hourly".
Plain numbers are seconds.

### Setups

A "setup" is a shareable bundle — a theme, sounds, categories and a set of
starter tasks — that can be applied to a fresh install:

    fmn.listSetups()
    fmn.applySetup(idOrJson)
    fmn.captureSetup({name: "Morning routine"})   // returns shareable JSON

### Sharing this

https://tasks.lucianlabs.ca/?model=ai opens the app with a short explainer of
the agent interface — a link worth using from a blog post or docs.

### Scope and limits

- The data is per-browser and per-origin. There is no remote API; these calls
  only work from JavaScript running on this page.
- Changes take effect immediately and re-render the open view.
- `fmn.deleteTask` and `fmn.importData` are destructive. Confirm with the person
  before calling them.
